# TechTide Harness Kit Catalog

Generated: 2026-05-17

TechTide Harness Kit ships **385 skills**, **348 agents**, **12 promoted external research candidates**, and **17 install roles**.

The best way to read the catalog is not as a giant list. It is a set of portable, eval-backed implementation assets for cloud, security, compliance, and agent engineering work.

## Role-Based Entry Points

| Role | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `cloud-security-engineer` | IAM/RBAC review, secrets lifecycle, security posture hardening, identity governance, live guards for access and key mutations across AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud, and Kubernetes. |
| `cloud-platform-engineer` | Infrastructure operators, IaC safety review, landing zones, networking, container platform operations, live deployment guards across AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud, and Terraform. |
| `cloud-dba` | Database architects, performance investigators, DBA operators, replication, and live database lifecycle guards across AWS RDS/DynamoDB, Azure CosmosDB, OCI Autonomous/Exadata/MySQL, GCP AlloyDB/Spanner, Alibaba PolarDB/RDS, and Huawei GaussDB. |
| `cloud-finops-analyst` | Cost optimization governors, anomaly watchers, budget runaway guards, capacity planning, and cross-provider cost estimation across AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud, and FinOps-neutral tools. |
| `cloud-solutions-architect` | Solution architects, migration cutover planners, resilience and BCDR reviewers, event-driven architects, generative platform developers, and multi-cloud designers across AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, and Huawei Cloud. |
| `cloud-devops-engineer` | CI/CD release engineers, deployment and rollout operators, live pipeline approval guards, serverless production readiness, observability responders, and artifact governance across AWS, Azure, OCI, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, and Huawei Cloud. |
| `kubernetes-admission-security-engineer` | API and image admission control: Kyverno, native ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL), Pod Security Admission, image signature verification, RBAC privilege-escalation review, and live admission policy mutation guards. Anchors the cluster's deny-by-default story. |
| `kubernetes-network-engineer` | Cluster network architecture and policy: CNI selection and dataplane (kube-proxy mode, IPAM, Pod and Service CIDR sizing, MTU, encapsulation, dual-stack), Service surface (EndpointSlices, internalTrafficPolicy, externalTrafficPolicy, topology-aware routing), Ingress to Gateway API migration, CoreDNS and NodeLocal DNSCache, multi-cluster topology (ClusterMesh, Submariner, MCS-API), egress topology and connectivity troubleshooting, plus Cilium NetworkPolicy and CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy review, CiliumEgressGatewayPolicy, Hubble flow observability, and Istio mesh in both sidecar and ambient modes including the L7-AuthorizationPolicy-without-waypoint trap. |
| `kubernetes-application-platform-engineer` | Golden paths and GitOps delivery: Argo CD Application/AppProject/ApplicationSet review, sync impersonation, RBAC, sync windows, and Argo CD Agent multi-cluster topologies. Owns the path from Git to running workload with bounded blast radius. |
| `kubernetes-runtime-security-engineer` | Runtime defense and workload identity: RBAC privilege-escalation verbs, ServiceAccount token projection, AWS IRSA, Azure Workload Identity, GCP Workload Identity Federation, and the OIDC trust-policy review that ties pods to cloud IAM without long-lived static credentials. |
| `kubernetes-pki-engineer` | Certificate lifecycle, CA trust hierarchy, and secrets management: cert-manager Issuer/ClusterIssuer scope, CertificateRequestPolicy auto-approval gap, trust-manager bundle blast radius, External Secrets Operator scope and auth, and cloud-backed CA integration via AWS Private CA, Azure Key Vault, and OCI Certificates. |
| `kubernetes-observability-engineer` | Metrics, alerting, cardinality, cost attribution, and telemetry pipeline: Prometheus alerting and recording rules, label cardinality, Alertmanager routing, OpenTelemetry Collector pipeline safety, and Kubecost chargeback and allocation model review. |

## Production-Safe Packs

- **Live guards:** approval-gated cloud and Kubernetes mutation workflows with target confirmation and rollback posture.
- **Enterprise missions:** discover, build, govern, prove, and transfer workflows for implementation teams.
- **External provider lanes:** Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Kiro, Lovable, Replit, v0, and Vercel assets that passed source and licensing gates.
- **Security review:** MCP/tool trust, untrusted code hardening, prompt-injection defense, and approval-gate design.
